statement: Identical, not within 1: all eight independent integers equal, hence every derived field equal (§1.5). A T0 failure makes the reproduction record `void` (§6.3) — fix the leak and re-run; do not widen the cross-hardware tolerance to absorb it. Note a cached baseline replicate CANNOT serve as a T0 replicate: it would be byte-identical trivially and turn the precondition into a tautology (§3.2) — and neither can a copy or a repeated path, both of which are REFUSED here (exit 2) rather than counted as agreement.
